steps.title: Tell us what you need done
steps.desc: A Level 2 charger for the new car, a panel with no space left, recessed lighting, or an outlet that quit — pick the job, your home size, and how soon you need it. Under a minute, no sign-up, works on any phone.

steps.title: See a real cost range
steps.desc: An honest range built on Classic Electric's own pricing, including the dedicated circuit an EV charger actually needs and the permit a panel upgrade actually requires. No teaser number that changes when we arrive.

steps.title: Pick your install window
steps.desc: Choose a time from real availability and a licensed master electrician shows up, confirms the scope, and gives you the final price before any work starts.

galleryHeadline: Recent electrical work across San Antonio.
bookingSub: Real availability from the schedule — choose a window and you're confirmed. No callback, no waiting a day to hear back.
